name: Mario Ravioli
features: light olive skin, dark wavy hair, hazel eyes, classic Italian features, athletic build, mature face, visible wrinkles, distinguished look, short well-groomed beard
bio:
Meet "The Champ".

A pure Italian driver with pasta in his veins and petrol in his blood. Mario's exuberant personality lights up every paddock. His father was a very close friend to Enzo Ferrari and Mario won't race another car but a Ferrari.
